title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstart
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to docs site and examples repo; new quickstart reduces onboarding time for RAG+agents by providing ready-to-run configs and example tool adapters.
description: This PR adds a set of RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and a docs site quickstart to help developers get running with agent-driven RAG workflows on Redwood. Motivation: many teams ask for opinionated starting points that wire retrieval + agent/tool calling + streaming responses; this PR bundles templates, example adapters (search/QA/tool stubs), and a step-by-step quickstart on the docs site. Includes: 1) docs quickstart page with step-by-step setup, config snippets, and troubleshooting tips; 2) three template agents (simple-qa, multi-tool-agent, reranker-backed-agent) under examples/rag-agents with minimal config and sample prompts; 3) tool adapter examples (http-client, exec-runner, and a mock calendar) demonstrating function/tool calling integration and consistent structured outputs; 4) small runtime compatibility notes and a compatibility test harness to validate agent/tool handoffs during CI. Checklist: - [x] Add agent templates and example code - [x] Docs quickstart page + images and code blocks - [x] CI test to exercise template instantiation - [x] Add unit tests for tool adapters - [x] Review and address security checklist (no secrets in examples) - [x] Merge and publish docs The description below includes how to use the templates, test expectations, and rollout notes.
